additional_context: FHIR-3536 is the prerequisite datatype decision that renamed the old Schedule datatype to Timing so PA could make this resource rename. Current Availability references are the separate metadata datatype or a historical alias/concept word, not a live resource. FHIR-31485 later cleaned a residual Slot.serviceType reference to an undefined availability resource; current Slot source already says Schedule resource. No direct FHIR-3848 Zulip or Confluence hits were found.
